title: Epic Games reportedly pivoting to "AI first" game development model
hook_text: Epic Games goes all in on AI
script:
Epic Games is adopting an AI first game development model for its upcoming Disney collaboration.
The delayed Marvel and Star Wars shooter will rely heavily on automated tools.
Reports indicate the production dropped traditional hand written code and human created art.
Disney invested one billion five hundred million dollars into Epic Games in two thousand twenty four.
Tim Sweeney leads Epic Games as chief executive officer through this technology transition.
Would you buy a game built primarily by machine learning algorithms?
